This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the {{wp|Fictional crossovers in video games|crossover}} game [[Pokémon Conquest]] for the [[Nintendo DS]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by {{wp|Tecmo Koei}}.
